record.text: 将所有随从变形成为来自过去的随机传说随从。
record.text_en: Transform ALL minions into random Legendary ones from the past.

face.name: 深渊滑行者索苟斯
face.flavorText: 千万别告诉索苟斯将来它会被主宰之剑给干掉，还有它的颅骨后来成为了艾泽拉斯非常热门的旅游景点……

face.name: Soggoth the Slitherer
face.flavorText: Don't tell Soggoth, but in the future he gets totally owned by the Master's Glaive and his skull becomes a tourist attraction.

face.name: 八爪巨怪
face.flavorText: 巨怪八爪，纷纷扬沙，紧紧缠敌，咻咻抽卡。

face.name: Octosari
face.flavorText: Eight arms of sand-flinging, foe-wringing, card-slinging fury!

face.name: 卡瑟娜·冬灵
face.flavorText: 她不是那种喜欢抱着树的精灵，不过偶尔的拥抱还是很让人舒服的。

face.name: Kathrena Winterwisp
face.flavorText: She’s not one of those treehugger elves – but she does like the occasional cuddle.

face.name: 暴龙之王摩什
face.flavorText: 摩什觉得没有什么问题是踩一脚不能解决的。如果有，踩两脚。

face.name: King Mosh
face.flavorText: He's a terror at concerts.

face.name: 阿诺玛鲁斯
face.text: 亡语：对所有随从造成8点伤害。
face.flavorText: 阿诺玛鲁斯是由混乱的奥术能量所组成的，所以消灭它存在相当大的风险。

face.name: Anomalus
face.flavorText: That's short for "Anomnomnomnomalus".

face.name: 山谷之王穆克拉
face.text: 战吼：将两根香蕉置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 其实除了香蕉之外，他还喜欢吃花生酱。

face.name: Mukla, Tyrant of the Vale
face.flavorText: Pro tip: DO NOT BOGART THE BANANAS.

face.name: 哈霍兰公主
face.text: 战吼：触发一个友方随从的亡语。
face.flavorText: 哈霍兰公主游荡在安其拉废墟的上空，梦想有朝一日能遇见自己的心上人，并为他生下成千上万个孩子。

face.name: Princess Huhuran
face.flavorText: She flitters around Ahn'Qiraj dreaming of the day she will meet a sweet prince, whom she can lay thousands of eggs with.

face.name: 沃金
face.text: 战吼：与另一个随从交换生命值。
face.flavorText: 所谓暗影猎手，无非就是精通巫毒妖术的暗影牧师。

face.name: Vol'jin
face.flavorText: Vol'jin is a shadow hunter, which is like a shadow priest except more voodoo.

face.name: 指挥官蕾撒
face.text: 你的奥秘会触发 两次。
face.flavorText: 两个人也是可以保守秘密的，除非其中一个是蕾撒。

face.name: Commander Rhyssa
face.flavorText: Two people can keep a secret as long as neither of them are Commander Rhyssa.

face.name: 驯犬大师肖尔
face.text: 你的其他随从拥有突袭。
face.flavorText: “它们都是好孩子，苔丝。”

face.name: Houndmaster Shaw
face.flavorText: They’re good dogs, Tess.

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

face.name: 恋旧风潮
face.text: 将所有随从变形成为来自过去的随机传说随从。
face.flavorText: 风潮不改旧传说，相看恍如昨。

face.name: Wave of Nostalgia
face.text: Transform ALL minions into random Legendary ones from the past.
face.flavorText: Ja, please don't freeze my minions. No stall, ja????

policies.ordinary: Native Taunt/Elusive and other-friendly Rush use original keyword/target/aura lifecycle. Natural Draw8 and Beast recruit use original draw, physical zone delivery, original cause and death slot.
policies.groups: Mosh captures all actual active living ordinary damaged minions, including source if damaged; ordinary DestroyBatch. Anomalus captures all active living ordinary minions and ordinary simultaneous MINION_ABILITY DamageBatch8, excluding heroes.
policies.banana: Actual complete client OG_122 COLLECTION_RELATED_CARD_DATABASE_ID1694 binds existing full EX1_014t effect; two ordinary own AddToHand deliveries, no name-only substitution.
policies.huhuran: Optional friendly active Deathrattle target uses original player-safe predicate API and a public boolean projection of current removable Deathrattle presence; no hidden state given to the rule. TriggerDeathrattles remains ordinary; exact CN target requirement policy remains pending.
policies.voljin: New finite public captured pair Health exchange: current remaining Health values, ordinary set-health attachments and damage reset, both mutations before either notification; stale member skips entire pair.
policies.rhyssa: Finite registered ordinary native live current-card profile, unsilenced active living controller source. Freeze original nonempty source refs at Secret acceptance, reveal/consume once, first body unchanged, one extra fresh-state body with original event/target/window. Multiple twice sources max2; accepted extra survives later source retirement.

uncertainties: Exact CN target requirements, current/max Health set layering, secret-condition recheck versus accepted body, source/owner and notification windows remain local policies, not official execution evidence.

Native Secret profile scope is ordinary current-card minion sources; existing267 Assemble templates contain no DAL_573, and no speculative dynamic passive-grant or component source support is claimed.
Generic unsigned continuation validation does not certify historical save provenance; no new persistent history or card-definition shape.
Complete original past pool and other open source domains remain unbound/incomplete; patch/hotfix and CN boundaries remain deferred.
